mechanism: Knowledge-graph retrieval plus a curated case base of reference code (DomRetriever)
evidence_scope: It dynamically integrates top-down knowledge-graph reasoning with bottom-up case-based reasoning, enabling iterative retrieval and synthesis of structured knowledge and representative cases
evidence_role: We develop a novel retrieval module (DomRetriever) that unifies knowledge-graph-guided retrieval and case-based reasoning into a dynamic, bidirectional process.
